decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the proven BASIC 518 trommel platform, so its value is largely confirmed and keeping it costs little, though the lack of recent evidence adds some uncertainty.
The flail shredder line had its own page and fits the core mobile shredding business, so with no clear negative signal the option is worth keeping open.

This single stationary fine shredder had weak visibility and overlaps with other shredders, which makes it a candidate for consolidation, but there is no clear evidence yet that its value cannot be realized.
The green-waste grinder line serves composting and biomass customers and remained after Product C was withdrawn, but its weak visibility keeps the risk of consolidation moderate.
The stationary pre-shredder line supports the strategic push toward plant solutions and was prominently presented, so further commitment is justified.
